title: BrainCandidate
description:
A candidate note waiting for curation (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 2.3): `.brain/inbox/<id>.md`, the same front matter as a note plus `source` and `repeat_of`. Served at `GET /brain/{repo}/inbox`. Deleted by curate once handled.

`id` is the file stem of `inbox/<id>.md` (the spec names the file, not a field). `repeat_of` keeps the spec's snake_case spelling: it is the harvester's judgment that this lesson matches an existing note, the primary evaluation signal. `status` is optional (a candidate is not yet a note).

slug.description: The note's identity; the file is `.brain/notes/<slug>.md`.

status.description: `pinned` notes are never retired or rewritten by the curator; `retired` notes stay on disk, out of the index, until the curator drops them.

runs.description: `runs.jsonl` run ids that taught or confirmed the fact. May be empty (a seeded note drawn from archived v0.6 data has no run).

files.description: Code the note is about (repo-relative paths). Optional.

decisions.description: Law the note points to (D-numbers). Optional; the note links the decision, it does not restate it.

body.description: The note text: one self-contained fact, gotcha or procedure.

repeat_of.description: Slug of the existing note this lesson repeats, or null.
